verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs say you connect GitHub or GitLab in about 5 minutes and then get automated reviews on every pull request. Review comments carry file paths and line numbers, and teams can react and reply to them in the PR thread. A community user whose employer runs it confirms that its PR comments catch real issues before human review. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that comments are posted inline on diff lines, stated review turnaround time after a PR opens, and independent confirmation of the GitLab path.
